glosses: nach Archimedes benannt, von Archimedes entdeckt oder erfunden

examples.text: „Wollte man es bei dieser Einschränkung belassen, gäbe es eine unübersichtliche Vielzahl archimedischer Körper, von denen etliche auch noch unerfreulich schief aussehen..“

translations.source_sense_description: nach Archimedes benannt, von Archimedes entdeckt oder erfunden

examples.text:
1629, William Bastian, “To the Authour” in Francis Malthus (translator), A Treatise of Artificial Fire-Works, London: Richard Hawkins,
Thy Archimedean hand hath learnt to frame
Celestiall Meteors out of Nitrous flame:

[…] sporting Nature, to amuse us,
Did startling Novelties produce us;
Mocking our Archimedean Sons
Of Art with strange Phænomenons,

Whoever should behold me now, I wist
Would think I were a mighty mechanist
Bent with sublime Archimedean art
To breathe a soul into the iron heart
Of some machine portentous,
[…] we are leaving the Campbell house for the train station, and I have my Archimedean experience: Elm Street . . . . . then . . . . . elm trees!

glosses: Having no infinitely large or infinitely small elements.
A member of The Archimedeans, the mathematical society of the University of Cambridge.
